about: Service level objectives. Generated by `eos scaffold ops`; yours to edit. `eos ops check` validates it (also in `eos check`); `eos ops alerts` writes multiwindow burn-rate alert rules to ops/alerts/; `eos ops budget` shows the allowed downtime. sli.bad / sli.total are PromQL with {{window}} for the rate window. Metric names below are what OpenTelemetry's http.server.request.duration becomes in Prometheus via OTLP (underscores, unit suffix; service.name becomes the job label); check yours in your backend. Objectives are policy: agree them with whoever answers the pager.

sli.description: share of HTTP server requests that did not return 5xx, measured at the service (OpenTelemetry http.server.request.duration)
share of HTTP server requests faster than 0.5 s (the histogram has a 0.5 s bucket by default)
